name: Indiana Medicaid home and community-based services screening
organization: FSSA / DDARS / Office of Medicaid Policy and Planning
description: Referral to screening for Medicaid services that may support care at home, including PathWays for Aging and disability waiver programs.
next_step: For a new inquiry, ask your county aging agency which screening route fits. If already in PathWays, ask your health plan’s service coordinator about assessment and authorized services. For disability waivers, ask about the Health and Wellness, TBI, Family Supports or Community Integration and Habilitation route.
constraints: Different programs have different age, disability, financial and care-assessment requirements. PathWays generally serves people 60 and older, with exceptions; Health and Wellness serves people 59 and younger with a disability. Waiver waiting lists may apply; general PathWays enrollment and its HCBS waiver are distinct.
